semiconductor_relevance: High — Yuasa Trading is focused on providing innovative solutions for decarbonization and efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly through exhaust gas treatment technologies.
summary: Yuasa Trading is dedicated to advancing sustainable practices in the semiconductor industry by offering solutions that reduce carbon emissions and enhance manufacturing efficiency. Their key exhibits include advanced exhaust gas treatment technologies that utilize hydrogen-enhanced plasma for effective PFCs reduction.
capabilities: PFCs reduction using Hydrogen-Enhanced Plasma Technology
